searchText: > Nethermind: not a nethermind issue, caused by CL. Adjusted block production to be similar to Geth. Only hides CL bug, doesn’t fix it. <@552133098075193354> Was there any sort of acknowledgement/commitment from the CL side to fix this? Covering up a bug like this usually ends very poorly unless there is commitment to fix it ASAP. The problem is that this sort of thing can very easily be forgotten on accident. Q: what was the intent behind having the block.gaslimit move in eip1559, why does it converge to 30M and will the block.gaslimit also be flexible post merge? it converges to 15M but it can be higher or lower at times it's usually 30M i think Gas limit is double the gas target. You'll be better off asking this in <#692078615269212180> I know CL teams are aware of the issue, but not sure exactly what the status is on the fix given that there weren't many of them on the call yesterday. This is still about CLs being too quick in asking for a block back. I thought most CLs gave plenty of notice (unless the previous block is late and then no-one gets any time to think)
